entities.definition: PermissionDefinition (含DefaultApproval字段，声明权限级别的建议审批模式)
entities.grant: PermissionGrant (含Decision字段，记录本次授权的实际决策)
entities.decision: PermissionDecision枚举 (deny, allow, require_approval, allow_once, allow_session, allow_persistent)

relationship: PermissionDefinition.DefaultApproval声明'建议审批模式' → PermissionBroker.Evaluate根据Grant状态/Deny优先级/Approval模式计算最终Decision → PermissionGrant记录实际Grant生命周期
manualApproval: 通过ApprovalManual实现 - 高风险操作要求人工确认
fullControl: 通过ApprovalFullControl实现 - 极高风险操作由Full Control权限控制
deny: 通过ApprovalDeny实现 - 策略级禁止
